# Camp Resource: Turbo-Fert Fertilizer Collector

Produces Turbo-Fert Fertilizer which can be equipped and thrown like a grenade to instantly grow any Workshop plants!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- AVAILABLE FOR GOLD BULLION PER CHARACTER. -

-C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Turbo-Fert Fertilizer Collector__

**Produces**

Turbo Fertilizer Grenades

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

1 Turbo Fertilizer Grenade

**Obtainable via**

Gold Bullion - Samuel - Ally - 750 Bullion

Gold Bullion - Minerva - List 10

**Produces X amount per**

4 minutes and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

9 Flamingo Units
